Description.English: Adds several cheat commands to keybinds (see readme). Helpful to test mods or simply to cheat.

changelog.1.15.3: - Default alternative execution to Alt+G. Report specific missing-island, selection, research, emperor and diplomacy prerequisites; retain short fallback/log errors. Preserve gameplay, existing shortcut identifiers and notification timing settings.
changelog.1.15.2: - Test global Side notification Delay=0 (affects all side notices) and IsUnique=1 only on the 16 cheat notices. Display durations, queue timeouts, Lua and keybindings remain unchanged. Latency and uniqueness lifetime require in-game testing.
changelog.1.15.1: - Change alternative execution default to Alt+Space+V for one-handed use. Two non-modifier keys require an in-game recognition test; saved overrides are preserved. No notification delay setting changed.
changelog.1.15.0: - Add configurable Alt+Shift+V alternative execution. Add emperor reputation +/-10 and own diplomacy cooldown reset. Replace ineffective population cheat with native workforce increase/decrease. Add money/goods subtraction test candidates and research cancel/reset alternatives. Set notice priority to -1 for immediate-replacement testing. Native effects and multiplayer still require in-game validation.
changelog.1.14.2: - Lead selection notices with the action, amount and toggle/reset behavior; remove counters and repeated default-key hints. Add concise context and restrictions. Replace the hourglass with the native tools icon on all 14 notices. Retain IsSilent=0 after the user confirmed visible notifications in 1.14.1.
changelog.1.14.1: - Give delete/destroy/reload shortcuts distinct labels; add label-only compatibility patches for the optional console and multiplayer speed mods. Preserve commands, identifiers and key defaults. Set IsSilent=0 on selection/error notices for an in-game display test; visibility is not yet confirmed.
changelog.1.14.0: - Anno 1800 controls: Alt+C/B select a cheat, Alt+V executes it. Adds localized selection notifications and guarded Luau dispatch for the existing 117 cheats. Retains separate delete/destroy, fast quit and reload shortcuts. Replaces the old direct cheat shortcuts; test the module entrypoints in game before publishing.
changelog.1.011: - Add keybind 'Shift;Home' to instant research the current active research (thanks JohnyBgood)
changelog.1.012: - Add keybind 'Alt;Delete' to delete (no ruin) current selected building/ship/unit even from other players. - Add keybind 'Shift;Delete' to destroy (ruin) current selected building/ship/unit even from other players (unknown if desync in Multiplayer). - Add keybind 'Control;Delete' to take over control of selected object (surely causes desync in Multiplayer)
changelog.1.013: - While using Control+Delete to take control of selected object: If the object is a Kontor or Villa, instead of changing owner the official TakeOver of the island will be triggered, to hopefully fix the problem that AI continues to build on the island you took over. Thanks 'hulker12' for the report.
